commands.review_summary:
The branch changes `EmbeddedTuiBackend` so every non-BTW local send waits behind any active non-BTW local run, and adds regression tests for different-session, `/btw`, and selected-agent cases.

PR surface: Source -4, Tests +96. Total +92 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. by source, not by live execution here: current main queues only the same run scope, so different session keys skip the wait path. The PR’s new tests model the bug, but they do so with mocked agent ingress.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] This needs maintainer boundary approval and contributor-owned live proof, not an automated repair, because automation cannot prove the contributor's real embedded app-server setup.

target.title: fix #98866: Embedded local agent runs should serialize globally across session keys when sharing one app-server
target.body:
## Summary

- Problem: embedded local non-BTW runs were queued only within the same session/agent scope, so two session keys sharing one `EmbeddedTuiBackend` could start local agent turns concurrently against the same backend.
- Solution: make the local-run queue predicate global for non-BTW runs while keeping `/btw` side questions and scoped stop/abort behavior outside that serialization path.
- What changed: `sendChat()` now finds the latest active non-BTW local run across all run scopes, and the TUI backend regression suite covers different-session serialization plus `/btw` preservation.
- What was not changed: provider selection, model execution, session storage schema, gateway protocol, stop/abort scope matching, `/btw` side-question execution, lockfiles, and unrelated queue/shutdown behavior are unchanged.
- **Why it matters / User impact:** Users can switch between embedded local sessions or selected agents without accidentally starting two non-BTW local turns that cross-pressure the same app-server lifecycle.
- **What did NOT change:** No provider/channel behavior, auth flow, persisted session format, model routing, app-server launch logic, or CLI transcript behavior changed.
- Fixes #98866

## What Problem This Solves

When the TUI uses one embedded backend for multiple local sessions, non-BTW sends with different session keys could bypass the existing local-run queue. That allowed the second local turn to enter `agentCommandFromIngress()` before the first turn settled, even though both runs share the same in-process backend and app-server lifecycle.

This patch moves the serialization boundary to the backend-local non-BTW run queue, which is the source-of-truth point before a local turn reaches the agent ingress path.

## User Impact

Before this patch, users who sent prompts from different embedded sessions or selected global agents could unintentionally run two local turns concurrently against the same backend. After this patch, the later non-BTW turn waits for the active non-BTW local run to finish, reducing session-state and lifecycle cross-pressure while preserving `/btw` side-question behavior.

## Origin / follow-up

N/A — independent root cause.

## Competition / linked PR analysis

- **Linked PR(s):** None. `linked-open-prs-for-issue.json` is `[]` for #98866.
- **Gap in linked PR(s):** N/A.
- **Why this patch is better/canonical:** N/A; no competing linked open PR was found. The patch is canonical for this issue because the queue predicate is changed at `EmbeddedTuiBackend.sendChat()`, before downstream local-turn execution.
- **Local real behavior proof advantage:** The regression exercises the actual `EmbeddedTuiBackend` queue path and verifies that different session keys no longer enter the local agent command path concurrently.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Two non-BTW embedded local sends with different session keys now serialize through the same backend-local queue; `/btw` side questions still run without waiting behind the non-BTW queue.
- **Real environment tested:** Linux host, local Node/Vitest runtime executing the actual `EmbeddedTuiBackend` class and `sendChat()`/`runTurn()` queue path. The agent ingress boundary is controlled by the existing TUI backend test harness; this does not claim a live embedded app-server or live model-provider run.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

```
pnpm -C /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-99179 test src/tui/embedded-backend.test.ts
```

- **Evidence after fix:**

```
$ pnpm -C /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-99179 test src/tui/embedded-backend.test.ts
$ node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/tui/embedded-backend.test.ts
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.tui.config.ts

 RUN  v4.1.8 /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-99179

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  43 passed (43)
   Start at  10:19:34
   Duration  5.48s (transform 3.83s, setup 1.01s, import 166ms, tests 3.95s, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 16.54s
```

- **Observed result after fix:** The new different-session regression keeps `agentCommandFromIngress()` at one active call until the first run resolves, then starts the second run. The `/btw` regression still reaches the side-question path while the non-BTW run is active. Existing selected-global stop/abort coverage still shows another agent's selected global run is not aborted; it is queued rather than run concurrently.
- **What was not tested:** A live embedded app-server process, live model/provider execution, and a full live app-server lease/shutdown sequence were not driven in this session. The proof covers the in-process TUI backend queue contract and existing queued shutdown timeout behavior, not live app-server lifecycle proof.
- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix.

## Review findings addressed

- **RF-001 / RF-002 / RF-004:** Proof gap disclosed. The current evidence covers the in-process `EmbeddedTuiBackend` queue boundary with regression tests, but this Linux session did not drive a live embedded app-server/client lease, live provider run, or redacted runtime log for shared-session waiting.
- **RF-003 / RF-006:** Maintainer-decision boundary. The current patch intentionally serializes non-BTW local runs per `EmbeddedTuiBackend`; the code does not expose a narrower live app-server client/lease identifier that can safely distinguish selected-agent runs that do or do not share one app-server. Narrowing queueing to only shared live clients would require a design decision and live app-server proof rather than a safe mechanical follow-up.
- **RF-005:** Confirmed. The remaining blocker is contributor-owned live proof plus queue-boundary design review, not a CI/lint failure. Current-head CI is green, but this PR should remain `status: needs proof` until live embedded app-server behavior is demonstrated or maintainers accept the backend-level queue boundary.


## Regression Test Plan

- **Target test file:** `src/tui/embedded-backend.test.ts`
- **Scenario locked in:** The suite now covers a different-session second non-BTW send staying queued until the first local run resolves, a `/btw` side question not waiting behind that queue, and selected-global non-BTW sends serializing behind active local runs while scoped abort/stop behavior remains scoped to the requested agent/session.
- **Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail:** The issue is the queue predicate, not model execution or app-server launch. Testing `EmbeddedTuiBackend.sendChat()` directly locks the source-of-truth decision before any local turn enters agent ingress, without adding unrelated provider or daemon dependencies.

## Merge risk

- **Risk labels considered:** session-state, availability.
- **Risk explanation:** The patch intentionally changes concurrency for non-BTW embedded local runs from per-session to backend-global. That may make a second non-BTW prompt wait longer, but it avoids concurrent local turns sharing one backend lifecycle.
- **Why acceptable:** The diff is limited to the queue predicate and regression coverage. `/btw` side questions remain outside the queue, stop/abort matching remains scoped by session/agent, and queued-run wait/timeout diagnostics still use the existing `waitForQueuedLocalRun(previousRun, runId)` path.

## What was not changed

- Public API / schema / protocol / defaults: unchanged.
- Channel/provider/session/security behavior outside the fixed path: provider routing, channel delivery, auth, persisted session records, and model execution are unchanged.
- Unrelated cleanup, docs, formatting, lockfiles: unchanged.

## Root Cause

- **Root cause:** `sendChat()` asked `findQueuedSessionRunPromise(runScope)` for a prior run, and that helper filtered by `sessionKey` plus selected-agent scope. Different local session keys therefore did not see each other's active non-BTW runs, even when they shared the same embedded backend and app-server lifecycle.
- **Why this is root-cause fix:** The fix changes the queue decision at the source-of-truth point that creates local run state. Non-BTW runs now find any active non-BTW local run in the backend before `runTurn()` reaches agent ingress; `/btw` and stop commands keep their existing bypass behavior.
- **Maintainer-ready confidence:** High.
- **Patch quality notes:** The change does not add a fallback, feature flag, broad refactor, or provider-specific special case. The only production behavior change is the non-BTW queue predicate; tests document the intended global serialization and the preserved `/btw`/stop semantics.
- **Architecture / source-of-truth check:** `src/tui/embedded-backend.ts` owns embedded TUI local run state and queueing. The patch updates that owner before downstream agent ingress, model routing, or app-server lifecycle code observes the run.

## Additional verification

```
$ pnpm -C /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-99179 exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/tui/embedded-backend.ts src/tui/embedded-backend.test.ts
Checking formatting...

All matched files use the correct format.
Finished in 30ms on 2 files using 1 threads.

$ pnpm -C /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-99179 exec oxlint src/tui/embedded-backend.ts src/tui/embedded-backend.test.ts
RESULT: changed TUI backend files oxlint passed with no findings.

$ git -C /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-99179 diff --check
RESULT: no whitespace errors.
```
